## Incident Overview

Discovered during post-merge code review of PR #258 (bug 9788 follow-up). Remediation finding from dso:code-reviewer-standard run on the merged diff after the bug 8a77 P0 (llm-review skip allowing unreviewed code to merge) was confirmed to persist.

See PR #258 diff at commit f9b439dba9. Filed at P3 as cleanup — not P0/P1 because the issues are minor (inconsistent field presence, weak input validation, test infrastructure correctness) rather than security or correctness defects.

Parent context: bug 8a77 + 9788 SC10 evidence work.
